notes: All five harvested tracks are North Face (5.8+) ascents; none can be assigned to Action Potential (East Face) or Ultramega OK (NE Buttress). The North Face is the peak's standard route and is not among the packet's routes, so it may be missing from our catalog, and its tracks (1799029, 1024365, 1027278) would fit it. Pin oddities noticed but not fixed: the 'Burgundy Col' pin differs between the two routes (48.5527,-120.5992 vs 48.5544,-120.5922; the tracks' col is near 48.5530,-120.5941 on the Paisano/col line), and Ultramega's 'Early Winters Creek Crossing' water pin (48.56803,-120.6298) is about 2 km north of Action Potential's (48.5502,-120.6282) and of the trailhead, which looks wrong. Our trailhead pin is 92 m from the cluster where four tracks start, so it is fine.
